g.text: Accepted production content index; persistence implementation pending T14.
Indented objects and arrays are embedded. I = existing service; other statuses identify pending design details.
Accepted separate immutable document; T14 pending
id / region {x, y, width, height} / action
References between documents (embedded objects have no separate boxes)
Booklet -> Production: currentProductionId; one booklet has many productions
Production -> Artifact revision: subjects[].artifacts[] current and accepted revision IDs
Artifact revision -> Production: productionId plus embedded artifactId and subjectId
Artifact revision -> Artifact revision: sources[] exact immutable dependencies
Production -> Operation: productionId on each operation
Human decision -> Artifact revision: targets[] exact revisions
Quality review -> Artifact revision: targetRevisionId and source identities
Repair budget -> Operation: bounded authorizing operation
Artifact revision -> Original asset receipt: assets[] and manifest page assets
Attachment receipt -> Original asset receipt: assetId
Display derivative -> Original asset receipt: originalAssetId
PDF export -> Artifact revision: exact book-manifest revision
Share grant -> Artifact revision: exact book-manifest revision
Share grant -> Booklet: ownership and deletion checks
Audit event -> Booklet: audited target identity
Consumption order -> Catalog version: accepted consumption snapshot
Entitlement allocation -> Production: subjectId resolves inside production
Production -> Execution profile: snapshotted profile identity
